# Texas Instruments (TXN) Q2 2026 earnings summary
## Q2 2026 earnings summary
### Executive summary
- Second quarter revenue reached $5.46 billion, up 13% sequentially and 23% year-over-year, driven by broad-based growth in industrial, automotive, and data center sectors.
- Net income for Q2 2026 was $1.98 billion, with diluted EPS of $2.14, including a $0.05 benefit above guidance.
- Free cash flow for the trailing 12 months was $6.5 billion, with $5.8 billion returned to shareholders over the past year.
- Announced a definitive agreement to acquire Silicon Labs for $7.5 billion, expected to close in the first half of 2027.
- Demand strength is broad-based, with inventory and capacity investments supporting customer needs.
### Financial highlights
- Gross profit was $3.35 billion (61.4% of revenue), with gross margin up 340 basis points sequentially.
- Operating profit reached $2.31 billion (42.3% of revenue), up 48% year-over-year.
- Free cash flow for Q2 2026 was $2.74 billion, a 271% increase year-over-year.
- Cash and short-term investments at quarter-end were $7 billion; cash and cash equivalents were $3.66 billion.
- $1.3 billion in dividends paid in the quarter; $5.8 billion returned to owners over the past 12 months.
### Outlook and guidance
- Q3 2026 revenue expected between $5.65 billion and $6.15 billion; EPS guidance is $2.23–$2.57.
- Effective tax rate for Q3 projected at 13%.
- Capital expenditures for 2026 expected between $2 billion and $3 billion, with continued benefit from CHIPS Act incentives.
